title: nageia insignis
intro: Nageia insignis, commonly known as the yellow staminate cone, is a species of coniferous tree in the family Podocarpaceae. It is native to New Guinea and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and anti-arthritic effects. The bioactive constituents of Nageia insignis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
